properties.name: namastack.once.enabled
properties.description: Enable Once protection. When disabled, annotated methods run without Once protection.

properties.name: namastack.once.transaction-manager
properties.description: Transaction-manager bean selected once when creating the default Once instance; empty uses an unambiguous Spring candidate.

properties.name: namastack.once.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Delete cleanup-eligible markers periodically. Existing markers protect their identities until deletion.

properties.name: namastack.once.cleanup.interval
properties.description: Positive fixed delay after a complete cleanup pass.

properties.name: namastack.once.cleanup.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum marker deletions per committed cleanup batch. A pass repeats until a batch deletes no markers.

properties.name: namastack.once.cleanup.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wait for an active cleanup batch during graceful shutdown.
